title: AAPS Builder
legal_intro: This notebook builds the AAPS app (AndroidAPS) for you, from the official source code at github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS. It runs in your own Google account. It makes your personal signing key, builds the app, signs it with your key, and saves the app and the key in your Google Drive.
legal_why_heading: Why you build the app yourself
legal_why: AAPS controls an insulin pump. In Europe (Medical Device Regulation 2017/745), in the USA (FDA) and in many other countries, software like this is a medical device.
A medical device may only be given to other people when it is approved, for example with a CE mark. AAPS is not approved.
The AAPS project explains that building the app yourself, for your own use, is the way to use it within these rules. That is why nobody can give you a ready app, and why you build it here yourself.
legal_rules: Use the app only for yourself.
Never give the app file (APK) to anyone else, also not to family or friends. Every person must build their own app.
This builder is a community tool. The AAPS developers did not make it and did not check it.
legal_risk: AAPS is not an approved medical device. A wrong setting or a fault can give too much or too little insulin. This can cause serious harm or death.
You use AAPS and this builder fully at your own risk and responsibility. The makers give no warranty and accept no liability.
Before you use AAPS: read the AAPS documentation (androidaps.readthedocs.io), complete the objectives in the app, and talk with your diabetes team.
legal_data: Everything runs in your own Google account (Google Colab). The results are saved in your own Google Drive, in the folder AAPS.
Your key is saved in Google Drive, in AAPS/KeyStore. You need it for every update. Do not delete it.
Nothing is sent to the makers of this builder.
sdk_license: This builder downloads the Android SDK from Google. To use it you must accept the {link}.
accept_label: I have read and understood this. I build AAPS only for myself, I will not share the app, and I accept the risks. I also accept the Android SDK License Agreement.
drive_hint: Next, Google asks if this notebook may use your Google Drive. Please allow it: your key and your app are saved there.
found_existing: Your AAPS key was found in Google Drive. Last build: {version} ({variant}) on {date}.
mode_update: Update to version {version} with my key (recommended)
mode_new: Start again with a new key
new_warning: With a new key, Android cannot update the AAPS that is on your phone now. You must first export your AAPS settings, then uninstall AAPS and then install the new app. Your old key stays in Google Drive (AAPS/KeyStore, with 'old' in the name).
new_confirm: I understand that I must uninstall AAPS on my phone.
confirm_needed: Please tick the box 'I understand that I must uninstall AAPS on my phone'.
first_time: No AAPS key was found in your Google Drive, so a new key will be made for you.
found_browser_zip: There is a ZIP file in AAPS/KeyStore. Did you build AAPS before with the browser build? Then use your old key (see below), so you can update the app on your phone.
password_none_hint: Your key is protected by your Google account only. (Technically the key gets the standard password 'AndroidAPS'.)
password_remember: Save the password in my Google Drive, so updates need no typing
password_mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
password_too_short: The password must have at least 6 characters.
import_toggle: I already have a key from the browser build
import_hint: Paste the value of your GitHub secret KEYSTORE_SET here. You can find it in the file keyStoreInfo.txt from the keystore export.
import_empty: Please paste your KEYSTORE_SET, or close this part.
variant_fullRelease: AAPS - for the phone that controls the pump
variant_pumpcontrolRelease: PumpControl - control the pump, no loop
wear_label: Also build the app for a Wear OS watch (takes longer)
start_hint: Building takes about 30 to 60 minutes. Keep this page open and the screen on.
keep_open: Keep this page open and the screen on. You do not need to do anything.
done_files: Your app is saved in your Google Drive:
done_install: Before an update: export your AAPS settings in AAPS.
On your phone, open the Google Drive app, go to the folder AAPS, then to the folder of this version.
Tap the APK file. If Android asks, allow installing apps from this source.
The download in this browser may also have started. You can install from there too.
done_no_share: Do not give this app file to anyone else.
done_key: Your key is in Google Drive in AAPS/KeyStore. Keep it: you need it for every update.
done_new_key: This is a new key. If AAPS is on your phone already, export your settings and uninstall AAPS before you install this app.
error_log_file: The full log is saved in your Google Drive: {file}
error_retry: You can press the play button again to retry. Your key is safe in Google Drive.
